channel.title: Pier & Point · Milestone
channel.description: Milestone changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · 490/499 Illinois Street (UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision and 499 Illinois Street): UC Regents bought 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000 (closed 2025-12-17), and is renovating 409 Illinois St (261,117 sq ft) into a new School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center with Suffolk and CO Architects, targeted to open in late 2029.
item.description: UC Regents bought 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000 (closed 2025-12-17), and is renovating 409 Illinois St (261,117 sq ft) into a new School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center with Suffolk and CO Architects, targeted to open in late 2029. Source: https://sfstandard.com/2025/12/17/ucsf-drops-767-million-expand-its-mission-bay-campus/.
